Offline.Dialog.10101.1: It'll be over when this bug is removed. But you need to stay focused until the end.
Offline.Dialog.10102.1: Data Synchronization complete. Today's choice is Kyo Kusanagi. Synchronization status looks fine.
Offline.Dialog.10102.2: You're technically a bug since you're entering via synchronization... which means I can't stop the bug removal system from activating.
Offline.Dialog.10102.3: It's not a system I can deactivate on a whim. You're going to have to think of this as light exercise before the final battle.
Offline.Dialog.10103.1: Bug removal program detected. Here it comes.
Offline.Dialog.10104.1: You're important to us too, okay? You're the only one in the Tuners who can engage in battle with the enemy in person!
Offline.Dialog.10104.2: Make sure not to get yourself killed. If an enemy's attack is too strong, then reduce the damage you take by blocking.
Offline.Dialog.10105.1: Good! The removal system will cease to function when you reach the end!
Offline.Dialog.10105.2: Use the skills of the character you synced with to defeat enemies in your path!
Offline.Dialog.10108.1: This is the real game now. Stay focused until the end.
Offline.Dialog.10108.2: It's been a while since I last fought against an exciting opponent. This is going to be worth the wait.
Offline.Dialog.10108.3: My name is Rugal, the host of this tournament.
Offline.Dialog.10108.4: I've prepared the tournament to add to my collection.
Offline.Dialog.10108.5: Take a look at those standing behind me. I have defeated each of them. You will soon join them as well.
Offline.Dialog.10109.1: What's wrong? Cat got your tongue?
Offline.Dialog.10109.2: Are you ready? Please don't disappoint me.
Offline.Dialog.10112.1: Your Ultimate Skill is ready! Finish him!
Offline.Dialog.10110.2: Hahaha... But don't think you've won yet.
Offline.Dialog.10110.4: ...Hey, are you listening? Can you hear me?! There's something wrong with Rugal's stats! They're crazy high!
Offline.Dialog.10110.5: Focus! Get back here, this is getting way too dangerous! Stop the mission!
Offline.Dialog.10110.6: I repeat, stop the mission. I told you to return safely, dammit! Get back here now!

Offline.Dialog.20101.1: The year is 1994. The King of Fighters is set to take the grand stage once again.
Offline.Dialog.20101.2: The rules have changed for this year's tournament. This year, teams of three will compete against each other.
Offline.Dialog.20102.1: I'm just about finished with you... How hurt are you?
Offline.Dialog.20102.2: I guess it doesn't matter. Nothing will change - you'll just be eliminated.
Offline.Dialog.20102.3: I finally found you! Hey, losers! What are you doing, ganging up on this guy?!
Offline.Dialog.20102.5: Gahhh! My knees! My flawless knees are going to be ruined!
Offline.Dialog.20102.6: I don't know why you're getting in my way, but this one's clearly a bug. If you're going to interfere, then I have no choice but to eliminate you, too.
Offline.Dialog.20102.7: What are you staring at? I'm in this mess because of you! Do something!
Offline.Dialog.20102.8: What is this? Everyone, stop that one first! We'd better take care of this before things get ugly!
Offline.Dialog.20104.1: Whoa! What was that?! That was amazing!
Offline.Dialog.20104.2: I've seen this before! That guy just now, he said he was going to participate in the KOF!
Offline.Dialog.20104.3: What?! You don't know what KOF is? The King of Fighters, a.k.a. KOF!
Offline.Dialog.20104.4: All the world's top fighters gather in one place with invitations in hand! It's a tournament to find out who the ultimate fighter is!
Offline.Dialog.20104.5: It's hard to miss - especially when it's all over the newspapers and TV. Do you only watch soap operas and never watch the news?
Offline.Dialog.20104.6: Do you remember your name, at least? We should start with that first!
Offline.Dialog.20104.8: Listen, this is my theory but... I think you can use the abilities of the KOF participants!
Offline.Dialog.20104.9: It might help in recovering your memories... Do you want to test it out? I'll help.

Offline.CharacterSelect.kyo.Desc: Kyo Kusanagi is the true heir of the Kusanagi Clan and their ancestral arts. Despite his rude and arrogant demeanor, he has an innate gift for fighting, and can reduce any of his opponents to ash with his pyrotechnic skills.
Offline.CharacterSelect.chizuru.Title: Priestess of Yata with a Strong Sense of Duty
Offline.CharacterSelect.chizuru.Desc: She protects the Mirror of Yata, one of the Three Sacred Treasures that seal Orochi. She goes by the last name Kagura, but her true name is Chizuru Yata. She hosted KOF'96 to find fighters capable of going against the Orochi Clan.
Offline.CharacterSelect.iori.Title: Red-headed Lad with Orochi Blood
Offline.CharacterSelect.iori.Desc: Iori is the last descendant of the Yagami clan, an ancient family linked to the Three Sacred Treasures. Iori fights enemies with his sharp claws and purple flames. Since entering a blood pact with Orochi, he sometimes enters a "Blood Frenzy".

Offline.Dialog.20105.1: Well... If you could fight like you did earlier, why don't you participate in the KOF?
Offline.Dialog.20105.2: If you compete in the tournament, you'll get exposure to the public, and that means someone might recognize you and contact you!
Offline.Dialog.20105.3: [FFD84A]You have a point, but I have to be skilled enough to enter the tournament.[-]
Offline.Dialog.20105.4: Skill won't be a problem for now. We have to get our hands on an invitation first. I heard only invited fighters can compete. So...
Offline.Dialog.20105.5: [FFD84A](Right then, a group of men with familiar voices appeared out of nowhere.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20105.6: What the?! Were they following us the whole time? They look pretty angry... Do you think we'll be okay...?
Offline.Dialog.20105.7: [FFD84A](I had no time to see if they were okay. Agitated, they started throwing punches at me.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20106.1: Great! As long as we work together, it won't be long before we become the best in the world!
Offline.Dialog.20106.2: [FFD84A](Whenever I talk about my ability and memories related to that, Noah puts them together like pieces of a puzzle.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20106.3: Knock and the door shall open!
Offline.Dialog.20106.4: [FFD84A](With her arms outstretched, she posed like a cult leader, urging her invisible followers to trust her.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20106.5: Why don't we go somewhere else to talk? They might come back again.
Offline.Dialog.20106.6: [FFD84A](She started tugging at my hand to lead me.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20107.1: Well, you see... I was looking for the owner of this invitation.
Offline.Dialog.20107.2: [FFD84A](There it was in her hands, an invitation marked with the letter R.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20107.3: It must be fate! I met you just when you needed this!
Offline.Dialog.20107.5: I think it needs a new owner, and you deserve it more than anyone.
Offline.Dialog.20107.6: [FFD84A](I reluctantly accepted the invitation, but... Do I really have what it takes to compete?)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20107.7: [FFD84A](Just as I was staring at the invitation, deep in thought, I could hear a familiar voice of a man somewhere.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20107.8:
Huh?
How'd you get that invitation?
Offline.Dialog.20107.9: [FFD84A](What's with his reaction? ...Was he the owner?)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20107.10: You! Where'd you find it, huh? It doesn't belong to the likes of you. Now hand it over!
Offline.Dialog.20107.11: It's not yours, either! You have no right to take it from us!
Offline.Dialog.20107.12: You leave me no choice, then. Our secret weapon's ready now, anyway.
Offline.Dialog.20107.13: I'll destroy you along with the invitation!
Offline.Dialog.20108.1: A secret weapon? That was nothing!
Offline.Dialog.20108.2: I don't see anyone who might try to sabotage us... Maybe we can relax a little now.
Offline.Dialog.20108.3: [FFD84A](After they left, I gazed at the invitation, a key to unlocking my mystery. And for some reason, tension overwhelmed me.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20108.4: Now, now, cheer up! Don't lose your edge.
Offline.Dialog.20108.5: Remember, it's where the world's best fighters gather! You should be at a level where you can stop your opponents with your gaze alone!
Offline.Dialog.20108.6: [FFD84A](I tried to scowl like she told me, but...)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20108.7:
Hahaha!
What was that?! That was ridiculous!
Offline.Dialog.20108.8: [FFD84A](Noah burst out laughing. I couldn't stop myself from laughing along.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20108.9: That's the first time I've seen you laugh. I'm glad you feel better.
Offline.Dialog.20108.10: I did say we should aim to be the world's best, but I hope I didn't put you under too much pressure.
Offline.Dialog.20108.11: It's okay to lower the standard sometimes! Let's focus on finding someone who might know you first.
Offline.Dialog.20108.12: If it becomes too much, then we can always try again. It's important to fall back when we need to.
Offline.Dialog.20108.13: [FFD84A](She made sure I felt relieved, and then went on to explain more.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20108.14: Now, now, what's important for us right now is to rest! Let's look for a place.

Offline.Chapter.1102.Title: The Intention of the Host
Offline.Chapter.1102.Synopsis: The King of Fighters, also known as the KOF, where the best fighters all around the world gather. Perhaps because of the lack of rules to...
Offline.Chapter.1103.Title: Psychic Fighters
Offline.Chapter.1103.Synopsis: Psycho Soldiers Team has fighters with psychic powers. However, the path to the ring is filled with enemies. There are just way too many attacking us for me to think that they aren't after my invitation. Is someone trying to make sure I will lose by not showing up to the match? The first round is about to start, and it will surely answer all...
Offline.StageMission.1101005.Name: Clear with all Fighters Alive
Offline.StageMission.1101006.Name: Clear after Using Tag
Offline.Dialog.20109.2: Finally, it's starting, isn't it? Let's see who will be the ultimate fighter...
Offline.Dialog.20109.3: Fight with all your might... and get on my level. I will enjoy watching you struggle until then.
Offline.Dialog.20109.4: Has the first match been decided already?
Offline.Dialog.20109.5: Yes. We're about to announce it through the broadcast and contact each team.
Offline.Dialog.20109.6: Good. I'm glad it's running smoothly. Now, who will be the first to entertain me?
Offline.Dialog.20109.7: The first of them is the Psycho Soldier Team, and here is their information. The other team is [FFD84A]{UserName}[-]... hmm...?
Offline.Dialog.20109.8: Hmph, these guys, huh? The kind I hate the most... The self-righteous type that don't fight for themselves!
Offline.Dialog.20109.9: They'll soon realize how pathetic their beliefs are...
Offline.Dialog.20109.10: Where's the information on the other team? Is there a problem?
Offline.Dialog.20109.11: N-no, sir. The team wasn't on the list...
Offline.Dialog.20109.13: Forgive me, sir. I can't believe trespassers were permitted to enter... We carefully selected the participants, but them...
Offline.Dialog.20109.14: It matters not. Let them participate. If they are strong enough to join... then they are more than welcome to stay.
Offline.Dialog.20109.15: The true purpose of this tournament is to find the world's strongest fighter after all.
Offline.Dialog.20109.17: It won't affect my goal in the end... I should be glad to have the chance to get my hands on a stronger fighter.
Offline.Dialog.20109.18: The more beautiful the flowers are... the more entertaining it will be to crush them.
Offline.Dialog.20109.20: Whew... It's not easy serving an authoritarian...
Offline.Dialog.20109.21: ...The next day, mid-day on the street
Offline.Dialog.20109.22: Let's retrace your steps from the beginning. Why were you lying collapsed in a place like that?
Offline.Dialog.20109.23: [FFD84A]I don't who I am, let alone why I'm here.[-]
Offline.Dialog.20109.24: You really don't remember anything, huh? Where you used to live? Someone from your past? Can you remember anything?
Offline.Dialog.20109.26: The fact that they are going to these lengths means you probably had a lot of enemies.
Offline.Dialog.20109.27: People like that usually come from... Yes! You must be from South Town!
Offline.Dialog.20109.28: There are a lot of dojos and fighters in South Town. I bet there are a few participating in the KOF.
Offline.Dialog.20109.29: That's right! You might even hear something like, "Hey, aren't you that missing Kyokugenryu student?"
Offline.Dialog.20109.31: There's a Kyokugenryu dojo in South Town! They have branches all over the place, from what I've heard.
Offline.Dialog.20109.32: Someone from that dojo, or anyone who knows something about martial arts, might recognize you.
Offline.Dialog.20109.33: [FFD84A]I'll be able to meet different people in the KOF... It will help me find out who I am.[-]
Offline.Dialog.20110.2: This is Chinatown, where the first round will be held! I can't wait! I'm so excited!
Offline.Dialog.20110.3: [FFD84A](Noah seems more excited than me, even though I'm the one doing the fighting.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20110.4: Maybe the headline will be something like, "Mystery Rookie Appears Out of Nowhere, Takes Center Stage!"
Offline.Dialog.20110.5: [FFD84A](I had a feeling she overestimated me, but I wasn't planning on losing my first match either.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20110.6: They have a cute girl on their team! Does that pique your interest?
Offline.Dialog.20110.7: How cute is she? Well... She's cute enough to be a pop idol!
Offline.Dialog.20110.8: But don't let her looks fool you.
Offline.Dialog.20110.9: She has psychic powers, like, shooting energy balls and everything!
Offline.Dialog.20110.10: [FFD84A](Noah tries her best to explain, but I'm not quite sure I understand what she's trying to say.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20110.11: It's a long ranged attack, you got that? It'll hurt if you get hit by one!
Offline.Dialog.20110.12: And their master looks like a drunk, but he gets tricky to handle the more drunk he gets, so watch out for that too.
Offline.Dialog.20110.13: [FFD84A]An aspiring pop idol with psychic powers, and a drunk... What a team.[-]
Offline.Dialog.20110.14: [FFD84A]By the way, you sure know a lot about them...[-]
Offline.Dialog.20110.15: What? That's... uh... Yeah, that's because they're famous! I also researched every participant. They're strong enough to be invited, after all! The more we know, the better!
Offline.Dialog.20110.16: There is nothing I don't know about them! Well, I've never actually seen them myself, but...
Offline.Dialog.20110.17: [FFD84A](Just when I was about to ask who the other fighter is...)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20110.18: Yes, I knew you would show up if I waited!
Offline.Dialog.20110.19: [FFD84A](It's them again. I don't think we can continue chitchatting in the middle of this.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20110.20: Gah, an ambush this time? Enough already!

Offline.Dialog.20109.34: So, you're trying to compete in the KOF... Not if I can help it!
Offline.Dialog.20109.35: Aw, come on... We were having a heart-to-heart just now! Can you get rid of this clown?
Offline.Dialog.20110.22: Never say never! We'll show you!
System.V_Quest.Text.14.Name: CHECK REWARD
System.V_Quest.Text.15.Name: Mission Clear Reward acquired!
System.P_CommonReward.Text.03.Name: Obtained Rewards for clearing a battle for the first time.
Offline.Dialog.9403031.2: Wait, Kensou, why are you eating right before the match?! You won't be able to move.
Offline.Dialog.9403031.3: As you can see, it's a meat bun! I can't fight on an empty stomach. I'm ready to go now!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.4: You don't need to be so hard on me. Look! Even the master is drinking himself to oblivion in the middle of the day.
Offline.Dialog.9403031.5: Gahhhhh, master! Not you too! ...Ah! Are those...?
Offline.Dialog.9403031.6: Good! We're here! These people must be Team China, our first opponent.
Offline.Dialog.9403031.7: The invitation in your hand...! Then you must be...? Nice to meet you. I am Athena Asamiya!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.8: [FFD84A](Noah seemed speechless by the very polite greeting she received. Standing next to Athena was a pale-faced young man, patting his chest...)[-]
Offline.Dialog.9403031.10: Hey, are you okay...? You look like you're about to die!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.11: Tsk, tsk... You look like a complete idiot... Pitiful. Here, drink this!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.13: Come on, Kensou, and you too, master! We mustn't be rude; greet them properly.
Offline.Dialog.9403031.14: *Coughs* H-hi... I'm Sie Kensou. Nice to meet... wait, what?
Offline.Dialog.9403031.15: We can't just say "hello" to them!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.16: We have to say something like, "You look tough, but I'm tougher!"
Offline.Dialog.9403031.17: I'm sorry about that... They're not always like this, but... We will try our best in the match!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.18: [FFD84A](Athena repeatedly apologizes and Kensou stands tall, ready for the battle.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.9403031.19: Hmm... Maybe I was wrong about them. They seem too genuine to pull something underhanded...
Offline.Dialog.9403031.21: Hahahaha, are you done judging us?
Offline.Dialog.9403031.22: Ah, just so you know, he's not just any old drunk; he is our master. You shouldn't underestimate him!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.23: Ahahaha... But our opponent doesn't look like a pushover either. You two might have a real fight on your hands.
Offline.Dialog.9403031.24: That doesn't change a thing! We will show you what we've trained for!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.25: Athena, you stay back and watch how strong I am!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.26: Hmph, we've trained in preparation for the approaching evil.
Offline.Dialog.9403031.27: I look forward to watching your battle, even without you depending on your psychic power.
Offline.Dialog.9403031.28: Well then, you better show us that you can fight without your booze!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.29: Just do your best and show them how it's really done! Make some fans while you're at it!
Offline.Dialog.9403031.30: [FFD84A](I nod with resolution and walk into the spotlighted arena.)[-]

Offline.Chapter.1104.Title: An Unidentified Attacker
Offline.Chapter.1104.Synopsis: The attackers who keep getting in the way are getting worse as the tournament progresses.
Offline.StageMission.1101007.Name: Max Combo 15 or more
Offline.Dialog.20111.1: Ow... We lost. Master, are you alright?
Offline.Dialog.20111.2: Gahh... My back... Ow... My wife is going to kill me now.
Offline.Dialog.20111.3: ... I can't believe I lost in front of Athena... Damn it!
Offline.Dialog.20111.4:
Hahaha, you're so young...
Are you more embarrassed about losing in front of her than losing in the first place?
Offline.Dialog.20111.5: Aw, come on now, Kensou... Master said this was to test our years of training.
Offline.Dialog.20111.6: But Athena, I... ...Wait. Hey! What do you think you are staring at?
Offline.Dialog.20111.7: I'm sure you guys noticed it by now... Ordinary tricks don't work in this tournament.
Offline.Dialog.20111.8: [FFD84A]Is he talking about the ones that tried to stop us earlier?[-]
Offline.Dialog.20111.9: Stop you? What do you mean?
Offline.Dialog.20111.10: Hmm... Maybe that had nothing to do with China Team.
Offline.Dialog.20111.11: I am talking about the tournament itself.
Offline.Dialog.20111.12: What is he trying to accomplish by gathering strong fighters in one place...? I feel an ominous shadow looming...
Offline.Dialog.20111.13: What in the world are you talking about, master? Did you get hit on the head during the match... Ow!
Offline.Dialog.20111.14: How dare you! I'm not senile! I'm just a little drunk!
Offline.Dialog.20111.15: Well, in any case, I like the atmosphere of this tournament. It's so energetic and... cool!
Offline.Dialog.20111.16: I'm glad we got a chance to fight against you.
Offline.Dialog.20111.17: Let's see... We must devote ourselves to training as long as evil continues to exist in the world. You understand, right?
Offline.Dialog.20111.18: Yes, I will train harder to save as many people as possible!
Offline.Dialog.20111.19: [FFD84A](The disciples nod in unison at their master's words and turn to face us.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20111.20: It was an absolute honor to do battle with you. Please take care!
Offline.Dialog.20111.21: Tch... Remember, you beat us! Don't go losing to some chumps later!
Offline.Dialog.20111.22: [FFD84A](Team China left the arena quietly after their genuine encouragement.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20111.24: What's with the cringy heart-warming comments? If you came out on top, then you should act like you did!
Offline.Dialog.20111.25: I've never seen a bug as strange as this one. I should've let him take care of it... I should tell him now...
Offline.Dialog.20111.26: No! I can't- I've come this far!
Offline.Dialog.20111.27: If I did that, he'd lecture me on the “importance of responsibility” again! I'd rather die.
Offline.Dialog.20111.28: ‘Kay, fine. If that's how you're going to do it, then let's see if you can handle this one too. Haha!
Offline.Dialog.20111.30: [FFD84A]China Team wasn't attacked like us... and they weren't the ones behind the attacks either.[-]
Offline.Dialog.20111.31: [FFD84A]What's going on...? Am I the sole target of their attacks?[-]
Offline.Dialog.20111.32: I was hoping we'd find some clues with this match, but I guess we're still empty-handed.
Offline.Dialog.20111.33: [FFD84A](Right then, I heard noises around me.)[-]
Offline.Dialog.20111.34: I finally found you... Did you think I'd let you compete in the tournament?
Offline.Dialog.20111.35: [FFD84A]They say the best plan for battle is to avoid it in the first place, but it doesn't seem like the right time to test it. I have to fight...[-]

GuildCoop.Tutorial.1: Fight the Wary Colossal together with your whole guild.
GuildCoop.Tutorial.2: Pick a guardian before the fight: its thunderstorm and blessing give you a head start.
GuildCoop.Tutorial.3: Practice to learn the boss's patterns. Practice uses no plays.
GuildCoop.Tutorial.4: Every tier changes the boss's element and cipher. Clearing a tier pays its reward.
GuildCoop.Tutorial.5: The guild's damage adds up: when it reaches the tier's HP, the next tier opens.
GuildCoop.Tutorial.6: You can play 3 times a day. The day's first play pays a reward.
GuildCoop.Tutorial.7: Check the ranking to see every member's damage.
